title: Starfall Bulwark
description: A dusk-canyon 3D tower defense built with three.js. A fallen star core wakes beside a void portal — build ballistic towers along the winding star-road, chain lightning through crystal beasts, slow them with frost, splash the armored brutes and catch the fliers with prism beams, and turn the tide yourself with three castable powers: Starfall, Frost Nova and Overload Pulse. Roguelite blessing drafts every third wave, random wave events, a colossus boss that stomps your towers offline — and a Deep Tide endless mode where enemies compound +10% per wave, learn to split, shield and burrow, grow armor with depth and march in ever larger colossus packs. Chase your best-wave record.
controls: Click a glowing hex pad to open the build menu, then pick one of 5 towers (keys 1-5). Click a built tower to upgrade (U) or sell (X, 70% refund). Cast powers with Q (Starfall), E (Frost Nova), R (Overload Pulse). Space calls the next wave early for +15 essence (or toggles speed during combat), F toggles 1×/2× speed, P pauses, Esc deselects. Clear wave 10 to unlock endless mode. Touch controls supported on mobile.
author: LightGame
